desc: Derive cost formula cost(l..r) = Σ (running_max − a_i) and monotonicity: cost(l..r) ≥ cost(l+1..r), so with l decreasing, max valid r is non-increasing → r moves only left, O(n) total.

Design incremental structure: deque of (value, count) blocks, strictly increasing front→back; prepend merges front blocks with v ≤ x (amortized O(1)); removal from the RIGHT is exact because M_i depends only on elements ≤ i (avoids the broken front-decrement approach).
Validate algorithm by hand on Example 1 (nums=[6,3,1,2,4,4], k=7 → 17), including the shrink steps for l=0.
Implement final code in the starter class (collections.deque, int arithmetic, answer accumulation r−l+1 per l).
Test on Example 2 (→ 12) and edge cases: n=1, monotone increasing array, strictly decreasing array, k=1, duplicates, large values; confirmed O(n) time / O(n) space.
